title: Top Five Industries where Freelancers Venture Into
what_it_is: Top Five Industries where Freelancers Venture Into

sections.label: Support for self-employed persons
sections.summary: The Government provides skills development and training support for all self-employed persons, not just those in the creative industry.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Manpower (Mrs Josephine Teo) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: The top five occupations for self-employed persons (SEPs) without employees, or more informally "freelancers", are taxi drivers, real estate agents, working proprietors, insurance agents and private hire car drivers.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Manpower (Mrs Josephine Teo) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: The Government provides skills development and training support for all workers, both employees and SEPs, through initiatives, such as those under SkillsFuture (SSG).

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Manpower (Mrs Josephine Teo) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: All SEPs, not just those in the creative industry, can access subsidised courses offered by Continuing Education and Training Centres appointed by SkillsFuture Singapore as well as certifiable courses that receive funding support of SSG.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Manpower (Mrs Josephine Teo) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: Eligible trainees can also apply for a training allowance under the Workfare Training Support scheme.

sections.label: Outreach through self-employed associations
sections.summary: Outreach mechanisms exist where associations exist, and efforts can be intensified, but are harder where there are none.

sentences.speaker: Mrs Josephine Teo
sentences.text: Where there are associations, for example, the sports coaches or the National Taxi Association, there have been mechanisms for outreach and we can certainly intensify the efforts.

sentences.speaker: Mrs Josephine Teo
sentences.text: Where there are no associations, it becomes a bit harder.

sentences.speaker: Mrs Josephine Teo
sentences.text: The reason is because if you look at the landscape of self-employed persons, although the numbers have been largely stable over the years, the occupations are very varied.

sentences.speaker: Mrs Josephine Teo
sentences.text: There are at least 100 occupations among all self-employed persons.

sentences.speaker: Mrs Josephine Teo
sentences.text: One assurance I can give to the Member is that where there is an association, where the self-employed persons have come together and they can identify common needs among themselves, then there is a way in which we can work with them to enable more of them to keep up with skills development.
